about: Tuning and evaluation probes for the collocation Feature (training/collocations.py tune). Each pair has a common learner miscollocation and its usual form, in otherwise identical sentences. Written for BandCraft AI on 2026-10-02 from well-known learner error types. Used only to choose thresholds and report recall; the check itself flags pairings from corpus counts, never from this list.

probes.wrong: Many students do a mistake when they rush the exam.
probes.right: Many students make a mistake when they rush the exam.

probes.wrong: Children should make their homework before dinner.
probes.right: Children should do their homework before dinner.

probes.wrong: Young people sometimes make a crime because they are bored.
probes.right: Young people sometimes commit a crime because they are bored.

probes.wrong: We had to cancel the match because of the strong rain.
probes.right: We had to cancel the match because of the heavy rain.

probes.wrong: A phone in the classroom can give a distraction to everyone.
probes.right: A phone in the classroom can cause a distraction to everyone.

probes.wrong: The government must do a decision about the new airport.
probes.right: The government must make a decision about the new airport.

probes.wrong: Most countries have done progress in reducing poverty.
probes.right: Most countries have made progress in reducing poverty.

probes.wrong: Scientists make research on climate every year.
probes.right: Scientists do research on climate every year.

probes.wrong: Floods can make damage to houses and roads.
probes.right: Floods can cause damage to houses and roads.

probes.wrong: People complain about the expensive price of housing in cities.
probes.right: People complain about the high price of housing in cities.

probes.wrong: Patients should eat their medicine at the same time each day.
probes.right: Patients should take their medicine at the same time each day.

probes.wrong: Every learner has to do an effort to improve.
probes.right: Every learner has to make an effort to improve.

probes.wrong: Politicians rarely say the truth about taxes.
probes.right: Politicians rarely tell the truth about taxes.

probes.wrong: The neighbours do a noise late at night.
probes.right: The neighbours make a noise late at night.

probes.wrong: Teachers should say advice to students about careers.
probes.right: Teachers should give advice to students about careers.

probes.wrong: He took a cold after walking home in the rain.
probes.right: He caught a cold after walking home in the rain.

probes.wrong: She has been my near friend since school.
probes.right: She has been my close friend since school.

probes.wrong: Quick food is cheap but unhealthy.
probes.right: Fast food is cheap but unhealthy.

probes.wrong: Big traffic in the morning makes people late for work.
probes.right: Heavy traffic in the morning makes people late for work.

probes.wrong: Education has a big importance for the economy.
probes.right: Education has a great importance for the economy.

probes.wrong: He drinks powerful coffee every morning.
probes.right: He drinks strong coffee every morning.

probes.wrong: Older people should make exercise every day.
probes.right: Older people should do exercise every day.

probes.wrong: Small shops cannot do a profit in the city centre.
probes.right: Small shops cannot make a profit in the city centre.

probes.wrong: Companies should earn experience in foreign markets before expanding.
probes.right: Companies should gain experience in foreign markets before expanding.

probes.wrong: Drivers who destroy the law should lose their licence.
probes.right: Drivers who break the law should lose their licence.

probes.wrong: Tourists often make photos of the old town.
probes.right: Tourists often take photos of the old town.

probes.wrong: The company had to pay a big attention to safety.
probes.right: The company had to pay close attention to safety.

probes.wrong: Parents should hold their promises to their children.
probes.right: Parents should keep their promises to their children.

probes.wrong: Governments must rise awareness of the risks of smoking.
probes.right: Governments must raise awareness of the risks of smoking.
